question: How does the effect of increasing education expenditure on per capita GDP compare between developing countries and countries in Sub-Saharan Africa?

qd_cpi.final_answer: The effect of increasing education expenditure on per capita GDP is generally stronger in developing countries compared to countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, as indicated by a higher positive correlation in the former group.
